room_description: A dimly lit room decorated with musical and historical items, including a piano, a suit of knight's armor, a mounted moose head, tribal masks, and a white cabinet.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the music and armor room.
Inspects the piano, noting the red roses scattered on the keys.
Opens the white cabinet drawer and collects a pair of clippers.
Uses the clippers to cut the metal latch securing the knight's armor.
Discovers a crumpled piece of paper showing colored, overlapping numbers '2508'.
Enters the code '2508' into the 4-digit lock on the wooden box.
Opens the box to reveal a tablet requiring a swipe pattern.
Solves the colored floor pad puzzle, which likely reveals the swipe pattern.
Draws an hourglass/X swipe pattern on the tablet screen.
Retrieves the gold key from the opened chest plate of the knight armor.

solution_steps: Find the clippers in the cabinet drawer.
Use them to cut the metal lock keeping the knight's chest plate shut.
puzzles.reward: Access to the inside of the armor

solution_steps: Examine the crumpled paper clue to read the overlapping colored numbers (2508).
Input the digits into the wooden box.
Solve the colored circles on the floor to deduce the lock pattern.
Swipe the corresponding hourglass/X shape on the tablet's 9-dot grid.
View the X-ray on the tablet to confirm the key is inside the armor.

final_action: Takes the gold key found inside the knight's armor and uses it to unlock the exit door.
